name: Germany
administering_agency: Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (questions); sat at test centres named by the naturalization authority

format.notes: A test booklet of 33 questions with four answers each, one right. 30 questions are nationwide and 3 are about the Land of residence. The full catalogue has 300 nationwide questions and 10 for each Land (160).

exemptions.age: People who cannot meet the requirement because of age are exempt. Holders of a German school-leaving certificate do not need the test.
exemptions.disability: People who cannot meet the requirement because of a physical, mental or psychological illness or a disability are exempt.
